user.title: Find your car
user.description: Looking for nearby CHR vehicles through your Bluetooth adapters and ESPHome proxies.

manual.title: Enter the car address
manual.description: Use manual entry if automatic discovery cannot find your car. It must still be reachable to verify the connection.

confirm.title: Connect to {name}
confirm.description: Confirm to check the connection and read status. Close CarLinko on your phone first so it releases Bluetooth.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.not_found: The car is not visible through a connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy. Check range, close CarLinko, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read status. Close CarLinko, check the proxy is online and near the car, then try again.
error.unsupported_device: The device did not provide a supported CarLinko status response.

init.title: Polling settings
init.description: Connect, request status, and disconnect every 1–1440 minutes. Changing this setting reloads the integration and reads status immediately.
